_note: EXAMPLE TO ADAPT. Written in Claude Code's settings format (.claude/settings.json, checked October 2026) because one real shape is easier to adapt than an invented one. Other agents use other file names, event names, matchers and variables; check your agent's current documentation (Appendix C of the book has a dated summary). On Windows, where Claude Code also has a PowerShell tool, match ^(Bash|PowerShell)$ and add rules for PowerShell commands. onFailure: block (Claude Code 2.1.295 or later) makes a hook that crashes or times out block the call instead of allowing it.
